skills.name: Practical work 3: identifying the biological resources of Cameroon

worked_example.problem: Sort {r} into plant or animal and wild or cultivated.
steps: A gorilla is a wild animal; sapelli is a wild tree (timber).
Cocoa is a cultivated plant (a cash crop).
worked_example.answer: Gorilla: wild animal; sapelli: wild plant; cocoa: cultivated plant.

cards.idea: Biological resources are living: plants and animals, wild or cultivated.
example: Timber and eru are wild plants.

cards.idea: The forest zone gives timber and cocoa; the highlands give coffee and tea; the savanna gives cattle and cotton.
example: Tea is grown at Tole and Ndu.

cards.idea: Record resources in a table and mark their zones on a sketch map.
example: Columns: resource, plant or animal, wild or cultivated, zone.
Use a key on the map.

check.prompt: Put the steps of the practical in order.

items.text: List the resources seen in the area or market
Sort them into plant or animal, wild or cultivated
Mark the zones on a sketch map with a key

pick.y: Gorillas live wild in the forest.
Eru is mostly gathered from the forest.

pick.r: an iroko tree in the forest
pick.y: It grows naturally in the forest.
It lives wild in the park.

questions.prompt: Is {X.r} a plant or an animal, and wild or cultivated?

misconceptions.explain: Ask two questions: is it a plant or an animal? Is it grown or kept by people (cultivated, reared) or does it live wild?

e: The forest has tsetse and little pasture.
It is too dry and hot.

questions.prompt: In which zone of Cameroon is {X.q} mainly found?
Put the steps of the practical in order.

right.text: Elephants live in the forest parks.
Cattle are reared in the savanna.

wrong.explain: Petroleum is a mineral resource, not living.

wrong.text: Tea is grown mainly in the Far North.
wrong.explain: Tea grows in the cool highlands.

wrong.text: Giraffes are reared on farms in the South.
wrong.explain: Giraffes live wild in northern parks.
